content: @op-engineering/op-sqlite 16.2.2 (June 2026). JSI-based SQLite library with synchronous native access — 5x faster than bridge-based alternatives. Cannot run in Expo Go; requires npx expo prebuild. No Expo config plugin needed; prebuild handles the pod setup. Supports vanilla sqlite, FTS5, reactive queries, and more. Zero dependencies. op-sqlite confirms BUILD.md choice — use this over expo-sqlite for data-intensive HSS recompute on write.
